data.name: Node_Patch_ApplicabilityHint

data.name: Node_Patch_PartitionPathHint
data.value: Select the actual extracted layout explicitly. A leading / is relative to the declared partition. System-as-root maps only system paths below system/. This does not detect partition identity or open images. Exists includes staged changes; connect it to an assertion when the file is required.

data.name: Node_Patch_InvalidPartition
data.value: Select a supported Android filesystem partition.

data.name: Node_Patch_InvalidPartitionPath
data.value: Use a bounded partition-local path with / separators.

data.name: Node_Patch_InvalidPartitionLayout
data.value: Invalid partition layout; system-as-root accepts only the system partition.

data.name: Node_Patch_BinaryFindHint
data.value: Enter hexadecimal byte pairs (up to 4096 bytes). Empty mask means FF for every byte; otherwise supply the same number of mask bytes. Matching compares masked bits and includes overlaps. Offset/length/alignment/skip use decimal integers; length -1 means to EOF. Alignment uses absolute file offsets. Expected matches is the exact remaining count after skip. No file is modified.

data.name: Node_Patch_BinaryReplaceHint
data.value: Uses the binary search range, alignment, skip and exact count rules. Replacement and optional bit mask must match the find length; empty masks mean FF. Unselected replacement bits retain their original value. Overlapping replacement windows fail. Changes remain staged until the outer workflow succeeds; preview discards them. Use applicability checks to distinguish already-patched files.

data.name: Node_Patch_BinaryPreviewHint
data.value: Replacement windows in staging order (before → after), not the final net diff. File publication is reported separately.

data.name: Node_Patch_FstabHint
data.value: Android five-column fstab only, not recovery or /proc/mounts dialects. Select literal mount point and optionally filesystem type; match count is exact. Set value replaces one field. Flag operations edit comma-separated mount options or fs_mgr flags; empty value creates a bare flag. The old-value guard checks the complete selected field. Spacing, comments and unedited content are preserved. This does not validate device-specific flag support or mountability.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcHint
data.value: Select a service name, an exact action trigger expression, or an import path. Section and statement counts are exact. An empty directive queries the header. Editing replaces or deletes body statements only; replacement includes the same directive name and its arguments. Old-value checks compare the complete raw statement. Quotes, escapes and continuations follow Android init syntax. Imports and properties are not expanded. This does not validate device-specific commands, service options or bootability. Connect edited text to a stage/write node to publish.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcAddHint
data.value: Append one statement to selected service/action bodies. Identity includes the directive and the specified number of leading arguments: zero for a unique service option, one for a setprop property key. Identical decoded tokens preserve the original; duplicate identities or different remaining arguments are conflicts. Other identities coexist. Count reports sections already containing the statement. New statements use four-space indentation and the document newline style. This does not validate command semantics or bootability.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcAddSectionHint
data.value: Supply exactly one complete service, action or import section. Identity is the service name, exact action trigger tokens or import path. An existing section with identical decoded header and ordered body tokens is unchanged; duplicate identities or different contents are conflicts. The fragment is appended verbatim, preserving its internal newlines and comments; required separator/end newlines follow the target document. Count is one for an existing equivalent section, zero when added. Imports are not expanded and runtime semantics are not validated. Connect to a stage/write node to publish.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcHeaderHint
data.value: Select exactly one service, action or import. Supply its complete replacement header of the same kind, without body or trailing comment. Preserves the body, indentation and existing trailing comment. Optional old-value checks compare the complete raw header. A new identity conflicting with another section is rejected. Renaming does not update start/stop commands or other references; check those separately. Runtime command, trigger and path semantics are not validated. Publish using a stage/write node.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcPlacementHint
data.value: End preserves the existing append behavior. Before/after requires exactly one body statement with matching decoded tokens in each selected section. Supply the full anchor without a trailing comment. Continuations remain intact. Repeated application requires the existing statement to be the adjacent body statement on the selected side, ignoring comment-only/blank lines; a different position is a conflict.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcArgumentHint
data.value: Zero-based argument index excludes the directive: setprop key value uses index 1 for value; service name executable uses index 1 for executable. Empty directive selects a single header. Value and expected old value are decoded text, not quoted init syntax; escaping is generated automatically. Existing arguments only; unrelated spacing, quotes, comments and tokens are preserved. Header identity conflicts are rejected; references are not rewritten. Runtime semantics are not validated. Publish using a stage/write node.

data.name: Node_Patch_InitRcReferencesHint
data.value: Checks start, stop, restart, enable and exec_start in actions and service onrestart commands. External service names are caller-declared, one literal name per line; imports are not read. Property-dependent arguments remain unresolved. Duplicate local service names are ambiguous, including override cases whose load order is unknown. The boolean covers only these named references, not full init syntax, other commands, interfaces, classes or bootability. Count is inspected commands. Connect the boolean to Assert to block publication on unresolved references.

data.name: Node_Patch_FsConfigHint
data.value: Edits the space-delimited metadata dialect consumed by UotanStudio builders. UID/GID are unsigned decimal; modes are decimal (493) or zero-prefixed octal (0755), not unprefixed Android octal. Query returns zero-prefixed octal. Select exactly one literal image path; duplicates fail. Edits emit decimal permissions and retain trailing capability data without interpreting or applying it. This changes sidecar text, not host permissions or an image directly. Rebuild integration, SELinux labels and xattrs require their own operations.

data.name: Node_Patch_FileContextHint
data.value: Select one text rule by its exact path-expression spelling and file-kind qualifier. Unqualified selects only a two-field rule, not every kind. Regexes are not executed or converted to host paths. Edit replaces only the context token, preserving order, spacing and full-line comments. Duplicate identities, malformed fields and old-value mismatches fail. Context shape checking is not loaded-policy validation; overlap/precedence, compiled contexts and actual image xattr publication remain separate.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageReadTextHint
data.value: Reads a literal regular file from a raw EXT4/EROFS image, including staged image replacements. Links, traversal, special files and files over 16 MiB are rejected; decoded text is limited to 4 Mi characters. Enumeration has entry/path budgets and supports cancellation. The full image hash is checked before/after reading and retained as a publication dependency. Hash output identifies the extracted file. Sparse/Super/Payload containers require separate extraction. This node reads only; image modification/rebuild is separate.

data.name: Node_Patch_InvalidImageBytes
data.value: Image capacity and extraction budget must be positive decimal integer byte counts.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageCapacityHint
data.value: Enter the target partition capacity in bytes. It is required and is not inferred from the input image size.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageWriteTextHint
data.value: Replaces an existing regular file in a raw EXT4/EROFS image and stages a metadata-preserving rebuild. Expected hash optionally checks the old extracted file. Identical encoded bytes skip rebuilding. Capacity is required; extraction budget checks declared sizes. Preview discards the result; publication occurs only after the entire graph succeeds. Each changed write rebuilds the image. Links, new files, Sparse containers, AVB/signature updates and device validation are separate operations.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageEditsRequired
data.value: Connect an image edit collection before applying it.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageBatchHint
data.value: Chain collection nodes through Image edits; leave the first collection input unconnected. Each adds one distinct existing file without modifying the image. Limits: 256 files, 4 Mi characters per text and 16 Mi characters total. Apply validates all old hashes, rebuilds once and stages one image; preview discards it. Capacity is required. Collections are immutable so branches do not alter each other.

data.name: Node_Patch_InvalidImageAttributes
data.value: UID/GID must be unsigned decimal integers; permission mode must contain three or four octal digits.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageAttributesHint
data.value: Reads or changes actual inode UID/GID and permissions in raw EXT4/EROFS, including root (/), without following links. UID/GID use unsigned decimal; mode uses three or four octal digits (644, 0755, 4755). Query returns four digits. Set retains file type, optionally checks old attributes and stages a capacity-limited rebuild. Identical attributes skip rebuilding. Hardlink aliases share changes; access ACL owner/mask-or-group/other permissions follow chmod rules while named entries remain intact. Malformed ACLs are rejected. ACL/capability/SELinux editing, AVB signing and device acceptance are separate.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageReadXattrHint
data.value: Reads one raw extended attribute from the current EXT4/EROFS image, without following links. Data contains at most 64 KiB of original bytes. Exists distinguishes an empty value from a missing attribute. Names use printable ASCII with a namespace dot, up to 255 characters. The image remains a publication dependency. No text decoding, SELinux policy checks or capability/ACL interpretation is performed.

data.name: Node_Patch_InvalidXattrHex
data.value: Enter an even number of hexadecimal digits without spaces or prefixes, up to 64 KiB of bytes. Empty means an empty value.

data.name: Node_Patch_ImageXattrEditHint
data.value: Sets or deletes a user.* extended attribute on an existing raw EXT4/EROFS inode. Hex values use paired digits without spaces or 0x; empty sets an existing empty value. Delete removes the attribute. Optional old-value checks use Expected exists to distinguish absence from empty. Hardlink aliases share edits. Capacity is required; preview discards the rebuilt image. Identical sets and absent deletes are unchanged. Security, ACL and trusted namespaces require separate operations.

data.name: Node_InterfaceHint
